summary: Back after a break? Ignore the noise, do these.
about: For a character back in Midnight after a break, from a few months to a few years. Retail shows you dozens of quests at once; this road keeps three on the table each week: the story to level 90, enough gear for group content, and your first Great Vault. Everything else can wait. Five short stages, then pick your next road.

steps.label: Pick one character and one spec for this season; your alts can wait
Untrack every side quest, so only the campaign shows on your screen
Finish the Eversong Woods story (Eversong In Reprise)
Finish the Harandar story (One Does Not Simply Walk Into Harandar)
Finish the Voidstorm story (Breaching the Voidstorm)
Finish the whole Midnight story, Arator's chapters too (Midnight)
Finish your first delve (Midnight Delves: Tier 1)
Reach item level 266, enough to queue for Heroic dungeons
Do two delves, prey hunts or weekly world activities for a Great Vault slot
Run one Heroic or Mythic dungeon this week for a Great Vault slot
Hunt your first Prey on Normal (Prey: Normal Mode I)
Reach item level 286, ready for Normal raids and Mythic 0 dungeons
Move into your first house (Welcome Home)
Pick your next road: The Long Season for a whole season, or First Steps in Rated PvP
